title: Sharp order in Erdős's minimum-area problem for polynomial lemniscates
summary: For a monic polynomial $p$, its filled unit lemniscate is the planar set ${z: |p(z)| 0$ such that $c/\log n \leq κ_n(\overline{\mathbb{D}},1) \leq κ_n(\mathbb{T},1) \leq C/\log n$. Thus the recently established lower bound has the correct order, even when all zeros are required to lie on the unit circle. The upper bound is obtained by combining a quantitative Faber-polynomial separator for a thin keyhole domain with an equal-weight midpoint discretization that preserves the degree exactly. We also deduce that the critical boundary-zero minimizers form a normal family in $\mathbb{D}$.
